v4l2-relayd on Omarchy

Pipes any video source into a virtual webcam device.

Package data synced 2026-10-18 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install v4l2-relayd on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add v4l2-relayd. It is a 12.6 KB download (25.1 KB installed), version 0.2.0-2.2, licensed GPL. Plays gstreamer sources into v4l2loopback devices. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install v4l2-relayd on Omarchy

v4l2-relayd is a small background service that uses GStreamer to relay a video source, a file, a network stream, or another camera, into a v4l2loopback virtual camera device. Once running, other applications (video calls, streaming software) can pick the virtual device up as if it were a regular webcam.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add v4l2-relayd
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.2.0-2.2:
    pacman -Qi v4l2-relayd

Open and use v4l2-relayd

v4l2-relayd has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql v4l2-relayd | grep /usr/bin/

v4l2-relayd requirements and compatibility

  • v4l2loopback kernel module loaded
  • GStreamer installed

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • glib2
  • gstreamer
  • gst-plugins-base-libs
  • gst-plugins-good
  • v4l2loopback-dkms

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: GPL.

Uninstall v4l2-relayd

omarchy pkg drop v4l2-relayd

Frequently asked questions

How do I install v4l2-relayd on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add v4l2-relayd. The download is 12.6 KB and it takes 25.1 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is v4l2-relayd free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL.

How do I uninstall v4l2-relayd?

Run omarchy pkg drop v4l2-relayd. It removes the package from your system.

What does v4l2-relayd depend on?

The package declares 5 dependencies: glib2, gstreamer, gst-plugins-base-libs, gst-plugins-good, v4l2loopback-dkms. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is v4l2-relayd a desktop app?

No. v4l2-relayd has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is v4l2-relayd in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as v4l2-relayd (version 0.2.0-2.2) in the official Omarchy package repository. v4l2-relayd contributors makes it. Project site: https://gitlab.com/vicamo/v4l2-relayd. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
